baseline_models.mechanism: Age advances on two fronts: force leaves the body's hard interior while whitening propagates visibly across its highest part. The ignition grammar makes the surface change active and spreading rather than a static color label.

activation_trace.role: Weakness and flagging supply the loss of force that has penetrated the speaker.
Solid bone supplies the load-bearing interior as the site already yielding.
Ignited flame supplies the self-propagating dynamics assigned to the visible aging process.
White ignition in the head directly binds the fire image to spreading grayness.
The head as bodily top locates the visible occupation at the speaker's summit.
Hair-whitening supplies the material result filling the ignition construction.

changed_reading.before: The speaker merely reports that he is old and frail.
changed_reading.after: Age is a two-front process: force has left the hard inner frame while whiteness spreads like ignition across the body's visible summit.

baseline_models.mechanism: Negated being turns the clause into a record across time. Calling the repeatedly addressed repairing Lord has not placed the speaker in either existential wretchedness or the hardship of frustrated striving, so remembered relationship becomes the warrant for the present call.

activation_trace.role: Being and occurrence in time make the negation cover an accumulated history, not only this instant.
Calling by speech supplies the recurring relational act whose outcome is being recalled.
The repeated address to one who repairs, nurtures, and completes encloses both bodily report and prayer-history.
Hardship and arduous suffering supply the experiential failure denied of prior calling.
The split mapping's state contrary to felicity supplies the broader condition the speaker denies having occupied.

changed_reading.before: He hopes that this request will not fail.
changed_reading.after: He presents non-wretchedness in calling as an established temporal record with the sustaining Lord, making remembered relation itself the warrant amid bodily collapse.

context_deltas.mechanism: The episode is first recovered as remembrance, then the call is doubled as verb and cognate noun and covered by hiddenness. This recasts the focus speech as an intensely imaged but privately held audience: bodily signs are visible, while the decisive calling is not public performance.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech anchors the contextual change in the focus ayah's opening act.
Calling by speech anchors concealment and remembrance back in the focus prayer.
Re-presenting something preserved or recalled frames the scene as a recovered prayer-event.
Raised voice and calling supply the acoustic act that hiddenness immediately modulates away from publicity.
Concealment covers the call, making intimacy rather than display the context for the focus speech.

structural_cues: 19:2 names the episode a remembrance; 19:3 pairs a calling verb with its cognate noun and then qualifies the call as hidden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembered narration, doubled calling, and concealment; I infer that these frame 19:4 as a privately preserved audience with the Lord. Alternatively, خَفِيًّا may mark low volume only.

changed_reading.before: The focus speech is an unmarked verbal report of age followed by a plea.
changed_reading.after: The report is the inner content of a remembered hidden call: visually forceful bodily imagery is entrusted through a socially withdrawn voice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following sequence converts bodily aging into a succession clock. Continuity is threatened by offspring being cut off, sought as an uncompensated gift, and defined through what follows and inherits; the promised youth makes the body report the narrowing interval in which continuity can still be received.

activation_trace.role: Loss of force supplies the speaker's diminishing capacity and makes succession urgent.
The yielding skeletal frame anchors the succession mechanism in the focus body.
The focus call is the act through which threatened continuity is placed before the Lord.
One thing following another supplies the sequence linking current dependents and the requested successor.
A descendant coming after an earlier generation sharpens 'behind me' into posterity rather than mere location.
The cutting off of offspring supplies the closed channel that makes the aging report consequential.
A gift without compensation makes continuity an unearned opening rather than remaining bodily capacity.
Transfer from predecessor to heir supplies the mechanism by which the threatened line crosses the speaker's limit.
The youth of the promised boy supplies the new temporal beginning opposite the speaker's late stage.

structural_cues: 19:5 moves from what is feared after the speaker to a requested wali and names the wife's barrenness; 19:6 doubles inheritance; 19:7 answers with a boy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bodily depletion, posterity, blocked offspring, gift, inheritance, and youth; I infer that depletion creates the deadline for a succession transfer. A live alternative is continuity of custodianship or knowledge rather than primarily biological lineage.

changed_reading.before: The body report explains why the speaker personally needs relief.
changed_reading.after: The weakening skeleton and ignited gray head measure a closing generational interval: the prayer seeks a gifted bearer through whom continuity can pass beyond that body.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaker's reply reaches and intensifies the old-age limit, but the answering speech changes scales: ease belongs to the Lord, while prior creation from non-thinghood outranks the creature's present weakness. The packet's alternate h-w-n mapping back to w-h-n lets the reply touch the focus weakness without denying it.

activation_trace.role: Creaturely loss of force supplies the obstacle whose jurisdiction is about to be limited.
Arrival at an endpoint turns aging from a vague condition into a claimed limit.
Old age supplies the explicit domain in which the endpoint has been reached.
Extreme age intensifies the speaker's boundary claim before it is answered.
Ease supplies the answering evaluation that reverses the force of the claimed bodily limit.
The non-dominant mapping to weakness creates a packet-backed echo in which the reply absorbs and reassigns the focus's w-h-n problem.
Bringing creation into existence supplies the greater precedent against which present depletion is measured.
The negated knowable thing supplies the prior zero-state from which the speaker was created.

structural_cues: 19:8 restates the barrier after the promise; 19:9 answers with ease and prior creation under 'you were not a thing.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an old-age endpoint, ease, creation, and prior non-thinghood; I assign the rebuttal arrow that present weakness cannot constrain one who crossed the earlier zero-state. Alternatively, 'easy' may assert facility without activating the h-w-n/w-h-n echo.

changed_reading.before: Weak bone is evidence that the requested outcome has become nearly impossible.
changed_reading.after: Weak bone accurately marks creaturely exhaustion but not the answerer's range; creation from non-thinghood makes the depleted body a lesser boundary already surpassed in principle.

context_deltas.mechanism: The successful call does not simply continue as more speech. Its answer produces a visible sign by selectively suspending intelligible people-directed speech in a sound body, after which communication proceeds by gesture and praise. Prayer's efficacy is thus shown as a change of communicative mode.

activation_trace.role: Spoken utterance supplies the initial mode that the later sign interrupts.
Calling by speech anchors the mode-change in the focus claim about non-wretched prayer.
A visible sign supplies the new evidentiary function assigned to the suspension of speech.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers supplies the channel specifically withheld.
Bodily soundness makes the silence selective communication rather than generalized collapse.
Gesture supplies the nonverbal channel that replaces ordinary people-directed speech.
Praise and prayer supply the communal act toward which the gesture redirects the answered call.

structural_cues: 19:10 repeats 'said' around the request for a sign, then bars speech to people; 19:11 follows with gestural communication and commanded praise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spoken prayer, sign, selective silence, gesture, and praise; I infer that answer transforms rather than merely rewards the speaker's communicative agency. Alternatively, the silence may function only as an external sign without revising the meaning of دعا.

changed_reading.before: Not being wretched in prayer means that a verbal petition receives a favorable verbal answer.
changed_reading.after: The favorable answer carries speech through a sequence of private call, selective silence, visible sign, gesture, and praise; efficacy includes surrender of the original speaking mode.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence does not depict the old frame being repaired; instead, gathered strength appears in the child, filial goodness returns toward the parents, and the promised life is carried across birth, death, and renewed rising. Weakness becomes the handoff point for capacity rather than the terminal verdict on it.

activation_trace.role: The father's loss of force supplies the depleted side of the intergenerational handoff.
The weakened hard frame anchors the handoff in the focus body's structural limit.
Strength gathered like strands of a rope supplies concentrated capacity on the child's side of the sequence.
Childhood supplies the new life-stage in which the countervailing strength appears.
Filial connection and beneficence make the new capacity return toward the parental relation.
Parents defined through birth explicitly tie the child's character back to the generation whose body was failing.
Loss of force and life supplies the limit that remains inside, rather than outside, the promised arc.
Rousing what is still supplies renewed motion beyond the death boundary.
Living animation supplies the resulting state at the far end of the child's narrated arc.

structural_cues: 19:12 opposes the father's weakness with the child's strength; 19:14 turns the child back toward his parents; 19:15 repeats 'day' across birth, death, and being raised alive.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies weakness, child-strength, filial return, and a complete life arc; I infer that the answer relays capacity forward rather than rejuvenating the supplicant. Alternatively, the child's strength may be a separate virtue with no compensatory relation to the father's body.

changed_reading.before: The father's weakness is a terminal personal deficit that the request must somehow overcome.
changed_reading.after: The weakness marks a transfer point: strength reappears ahead in the child, returns as filial good, and is placed within a life arc extending beyond death.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the fire branches are distant from the ordinary surface senses of 'behind' and 'inherit.' It remains valid as an activation because two consecutive packet branches connect latent and re-stirred fire directly to the focus ignition while ordinary inheritance anchors the sequence; downstream prose should mark it as secondary lexical imagery, not a claim that those surfaces primarily mean fire.

activation_trace.role: Ignited flame supplies the visible fire already consuming the old head as whiteness.
Fire hidden in a flint supplies a second, still-latent ignition located 'behind' the speaker.
Inheritance supplies the explicit transfer channel that keeps the fire sequence tied to succession.
Stirring embers until they ignite supplies the exploratory image of inherited continuity becoming active.

changed_reading.before: The focus ignition is only a consuming image of the speaker's gray age.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, visible white fire in the old head is paired with a latent fire behind him and re-stirred through inheritance, turning depletion into a possible relay of flame.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the bones-and-joints branch is form-distant from the surface blessing of peace. It remains anchored because the focus explicitly names bone and the packet supplies that branch under the later s-l-m occurrence; downstream prose should render it only as a faint lexical answer in which safety reaches the skeletal complaint, never as the direct sense of سَلَام.

activation_trace.role: Solid bone supplies the explicit skeletal structure weakened in the focus.
Safety from harm supplies the surface blessing that can answer the focus vulnerability.
Bones and joints supply the branch-distant bodily bridge back to the weakened skeleton.

changed_reading.before: The later peace blessing is unrelated to the focus ayah's skeletal complaint.
changed_reading.after: At an exploratory branch level, peace and safety faintly reach back to bone and joint, answering the weakened frame with a life-spanning blessing of integrity.

strongest_changes: The aged body becomes a succession clock: structural weakness marks the point at which continuity must pass to a gifted heir.
The reply re-scales w-h-n weakness against h-w-n ease and prior creation from non-thinghood, so incapacity belongs to the creature rather than the answerer.
Successful calling changes media: hidden speech becomes selective silence, visible sign, gesture, and praise.
The father's depleted strength reappears forward in the child instead of being narrated as restoration of the old body.
summary.what_was_special: The packet produced paired reversals rather than one gloss: inward weakness and outward ignition, visible bodily signs and hidden calling, old-body depletion and child-strength. Branch-distant fire-relay and skeletal-peace links remain contained as outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether succession is primarily biological lineage or continuity of custodianship, knowledge, and service.
Whether the h-w-n to w-h-n alternate mapping should be heard as an intentional reversal or only a packet-level lexical activation.
How strongly the prepositional construction بِدُعَائِكَ supports a history of the speaker's calling rather than another relational nuance of دعاء.
The latent-fire and skeletal-peace outliers depend on distant branches and should not control a primary rendering.
